language.zh: Gui 只接受 en 或 zh-CN；留空跟随系统语言。与 Ghostty 不同，这个值可以在运行时重载。
language.en: Gui accepts en or zh-CN; leave it empty to follow the system language. Unlike Ghostty, the value can be reloaded at runtime.

tab-position.zh: 标签栏位置：top、left 或 right。
tab-position.en: Where the tab rail sits — top, left or right.

compact.zh: true（默认）时窗格贴边铺满，只用 1 DIP 分隔线；false 时窗格是浮起的圆角卡片。
compact.en: true (default) runs panes edge to edge with 1 DIP dividers; false floats them as rounded cards.

sidebar-width-left.zh: 左侧标签栏宽度（DIP）。拖动边界时由应用写回配置文件。
sidebar-width-left.en: The left tab rail's width in DIPs, written back by the app when you drag its edge.

sidebar-width-right.zh: 右侧标签栏宽度（DIP）。拖动边界时由应用写回配置文件。
sidebar-width-right.en: The right tab rail's width in DIPs, written back by the app when you drag its edge.

debug-tap.zh: 把收发两个方向的原始 VT 字节流按十六进制写进日志。
debug-tap.en: Record the raw VT byte stream in both directions as hex in the log.

crash-dumps.zh: 向 Windows 错误报告注册完整转储，崩溃时在 %TEMP%\gui-dumps 留下 dump。
crash-dumps.en: Register with Windows Error Reporting for full dumps, left in %TEMP%\gui-dumps on a crash.

scrollback-limit-bytes.zh: Gui 把 Ghostty 的 scrollback-limit 拆成两个键：这个按字节，scrollback-limit-lines 按行。整数（支持 0x 写法）、unlimited 或 0（关闭回滚）。
scrollback-limit-bytes.en: Gui splits Ghostty's scrollback-limit in two: this one caps bytes, scrollback-limit-lines caps rows. An integer (0x… works), unlimited, or 0 to disable scrollback.

scrollback-limit-lines.zh: 回滚行数上限，默认 unlimited。它与字节上限同时生效，谁先到就按谁裁剪历史。
scrollback-limit-lines.en: Row cap for the scrollback, unlimited by default. It applies together with the byte cap; whichever is reached first trims the history.

window-theme.zh: Gui 只接受 system（默认）、light、dark。窗体是中性表面：不会采用终端背景色，终端主题也不会重绘窗体。
window-theme.en: Gui accepts system (default), light or dark only. The window chrome is a neutral surface: it never takes the terminal's background, and the terminal theme never repaints it.

clipboard-read.zh: allow 或 deny。ask 在这个构建里没有阻塞式确认，按 deny 处理。
clipboard-read.en: allow or deny. ask has no blocking prompt in this build, so it behaves like deny.

copy-on-select.zh: none / primary / clipboard / both。Windows 没有选区剪贴板，所以 primary 不起作用，both 等于复制到系统剪贴板。
copy-on-select.en: none, primary, clipboard or both. Windows has no selection clipboard, so primary does nothing and both copies to the system clipboard.

background-opacity.zh: 小于 1 时整个窗口（含窗体）一次着色，不会叠加在系统亚克力上；background-blur 决定背后是亚克力还是纯色。
background-opacity.en: Below 1 the whole window, chrome included, is tinted once instead of stacking on the system acrylic; background-blur picks acrylic or a plain tint.

background-blur.zh: true 用亚克力；false 在 Windows 11 上是不要模糊的纯色底色（Windows 10 仍是亚克力，和 Windows Terminal 一样）。
background-blur.en: true uses acrylic; false paints an unblurred tint on Windows 11 (Windows 10 keeps acrylic, as Windows Terminal does).

mouse-scroll-multiplier.zh: 每格滚轮滚动多少行（默认 3）。precision 写法会被接受，但 Windows 滚轮是离散设备。
mouse-scroll-multiplier.en: Rows per wheel notch (default 3). The precision form is accepted, but the Windows wheel is a discrete device.

keybind.zh: 格式是 trigger=action；重复的触发器后者覆盖前者，空动作解绑，clear 清空全部默认绑定。`gui +list-keybinds` 列出当前生效的绑定，动作清单和默认值见「按键绑定」一页。
keybind.en: The format is trigger=action; a duplicate trigger overwrites the earlier one, an empty action unbinds it, and clear drops every default. `gui +list-keybinds` prints the bindings in effect; the Keybinds page lists the actions and the defaults.

theme.zh: 一个主题名，或 light:X,dark:Y 分别指定明暗；Ghostty 主题随程序分发。只有 window-theme 选中的那一半会被绘制。
theme.en: A theme name, or light:X,dark:Y for separate appearances; Ghostty themes ship with the app. Only the half window-theme selects is painted.

shell-integration.zh: Windows 上只注入 PowerShell 和 bash；其它 shell 会给出提示，但不会被改动。
shell-integration.en: On Windows only PowerShell and bash are injected; other shells get a notice and are left alone.
